errors.quote: Executing such a permutation is a sort of data on a tape, costing time proportional to the line length times a logarithm of it
errors.problem: The paper (lines 3692-3693) gives each label-and-sort for P_t and P_s^{-1} a cost of O(tp log t) on a line of t entries of O(p) bits. That is an upper bound, and it includes the word length p. The page leaves out the factor p and says 'proportional', which suggests a tight cost. The point that matters, the extra logarithmic factor, is still right.
